sloka: सो अपश्यद् भूमि भागामः च गर्त प्रस्रवणानि च ।सुवर्ण वृक्षान् अपरान् ददर्श शिखि सम्निभान् ॥५-१४-३८॥
transliteration: so apaśyad bhūmi bhāgāmaḥ ca garta prasravaṇāni ca ।suvarṇa vṛkṣān aparān dadarśa śikhi samnibhān ॥5-14-38॥

translations.english: He beheld several pieces of land and streams flowing out of the springs. He also noticed golden trees asresplendent as fire.
